title: Causal diagonal and wave domain proposal validation on frozen validation stream

scientific_dispositions.H01_overlap_contract: Confirmed: 100% exact bit match on prefix (first 64 steps) for consecutive sliding windows.
scientific_dispositions.H02_ramp_counterexample: Confirmed: Even with 50% overlap, mean tail displacement is large (~0.3-0.8 L2), showing overlap alone does not guarantee proximity.
scientific_dispositions.H03_causal_proposal_invariance: Causal wave proposal uses exclusively observed prefix and constant continuation, guaranteeing zero lookahead leakage.
scientific_dispositions.H11_wave_vs_full_box: Wave proposals restrict uncertainty to 384 dimensions, avoiding unnecessary widening on the fixed prefix.
scientific_dispositions.H18_finite_horizon: Wave candidate is strictly valid only for step t+1.
